Detailed Description

The OpenClovis Performance Management Library is used monitor and collect statistics information on the resources.

It helps to
  • Collect statistical information from the PM attributes at the configured interval.
  • Define Threshold Crossing Alarms (TCA) to the PM attributes with lower and upper threshold boundaries.
  • Fetch PM attributes values (in the configured interval) and cache into COR for fast retrieval from north bound.
